text:
I’m passionate, hard-working, and would love to help build your Google Sheets meal planning document.

With 5 years of experience in data analysis, Excel, Google Sheets, Power BI, SQL, and data visualization, I’m comfortable organizing information cleanly and making it easy to use. For Juniper & Ash Home, I built customer segments from Shopify order exports using Google Sheets and Looker Studio, and the work helped identify that the top segment represented 9% of customers and 41% of revenue, while email revenue increased by 19%.

For your project, I can compile 20 healthy, no-red-meat meals with varied, ethnically diverse recipes and accessible ingredients, all structured clearly in Google Sheets. I’d make the sheet easy to update, filter, and use for meal planning.
